Container.Name: Chrysopoeia
Container.Overview: Chrysopoeia converts your movie and TV library to smaller or more compatible formats (AV1, HEVC, H.264 or VP9) in the background, and replaces an original only after the new file has been fully decoded and visually compared against it. Pick a folder and a goal in the web UI; hardware encoders and the number of jobs to run at once are detected automatically. Intel or AMD graphics: install the Intel GPU TOP or Radeon TOP plugin and keep the /dev/dri device below (remove that entry if your server has no /dev/dri, or the container will not start). NVIDIA: install the Nvidia-Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters, and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (under Show more settings) to all or your GPU's UUID.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database and settings. Small; include it in your appdata backup.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media. /mnt/user/ shows every share; narrow it to the share you want converted, e.g. /mnt/user/media/. Chrysopoeia needs write access to replace files.

Config.Name: Transcode cache
Config.Description: Optional: an SSD/cache-pool folder for in-progress files, e.g. /mnt/cache/chrysopoeia-temp/. Leave empty to write work files next to each original.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU
Config.Description: Intel Quick Sync or AMD graphics for hardware encoding. Remove this entry if your server has no /dev/dri (NVIDIA-only or no GPU), otherwise the container will not start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id files are written as. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id files are written as. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions for new files. 002 lets the users group edit them.

Config.Name: HW_ACCEL
Config.Description: auto uses the best hardware encoder that passes a test encode, else the CPU. Or force one of: cpu, nvenc, qsv, vaapi, amf.

Config.Name: MAX_JOBS
Config.Description: Files to convert at once. Empty = automatic, based on CPU cores, memory and GPU. You can also change this in the app.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: all, or your GPU's UUID from the Nvidia-Driver plugin page. Also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.
